result.topic_en: Notes on solving linear Diophantine equations in primes (including twin primes), a plan to treat this via Weierstrass's theory of elementary factors and the Riemann–Roch theorem, primes among the values of a polynomial, remarks on the nature of mathematics, and a sketch of a proof of the fundamental theorem of algebra.
